_comment: TEST-PREP draft profiles. Default: crtqa_outline (v3). Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/test-prep.md. TBD rules: docs/test-prep-tbd-contract.json.

crtqa_outline.description: CRTQA-shaped executable outline: full case matrix from case_outline[]; human-fill session literals only.
crtqa_outline.actions_policy: Expand every case_outline row into numbered action/result pair; 1:1 parity required.
crtqa_outline.results_policy: Observable check per action; requirement keys (CRT-####) only in results[].

teaching.description: Legacy TEST-PREP v2 teaching drafts (opt-in via draft_profile=teaching).
teaching.actions_policy: Up to illustration_budget worked sub-scenarios per check; remainder [TBD: …] per coverage.
teaching.results_policy: Teach checklist intent even when actions are mostly [TBD].

min_case_count_matrix.note: Aligned with CRTQA-10177 ladder vignette count.

_min_case_lookup: First matching matrix row (verification_class + calculation_contract); else class default_min_case_count from test-verification-classes.json; else default_min_case_count.
